svg.title: Slot selection model per-step diagram
svg.desc: Per-step loop of the slot selection model: action selection, GRU update, evidence accumulation, and classification.

g.text: h, E = zeros([B, 512]) · selected_mask = zeros([B, K]) · slot_embeds = input_proj(slots)
logits = cat([scores, stop_head(h)]) → mask selected slots (−∞) → sample a_t
x_t = slot_embeds[:, a_t] h_new = GRU(x_t, h) delta = h_new − h h = h_new
